items.question: Who imposed a curse upon the mantras, rendering them averse in effect?
premises: The mantras were acted upon and made subject to a condition.
The divine teacher was the agent of this action.
items.inference: The divine teacher cursed the mantras, causing their adverse condition.
uncertainties: Whether kṛtā functions as a separate action alongside śāpitāḥ or intensifies the result is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: The mantras were made and cursed by the teacher of the gods.
